non_blocking_findings.issue: Two surviving mutants: (a) tools/catalogue_stats.gd:~57 'teff == 0.0 and vmag == 99.0' still passes if the v == 99 clause is dropped; (b) sky/star_catalogue.gd size check '!=' still passes as '<'. Add a fixture record with teff 0, v 12, flags 0 (must be a violation) and a 3-record bin with a valid sha but count 2 in the sidecar.

cns5.dat is pinned but not in the public bucket; every clean machine and CI job that needs catalogue-verify downloads 4.5 MB from VizieR. A maintainer should run make sky-publish. make test itself does not need it (it reads only committed bins).

M-dwarf share is over complete rows. For quick this excludes 770 missing-photometry rows (5138 of 5908). The plan says 'complete rows', so this is correct, but the printed line shows 'count 5908' beside 'complete 5138'; the sidecar's count_excluded is 0 for quick, which can read as a contradiction. A word of explanation in the output would help.
started and completed are the same timestamp (19:42:20Z), so velocity data for M1.2c is meaningless.

sky-inputs now depends on catalogue-inputs, so make sky-regen newly downloads cns5.dat and requires its pin. Intended, and covered by the verify step, but it is a behaviour change for the sky pipeline worth a changelog line.

deviation_verdicts.from_files instead of load: Accepted. Clearer name for a (bin, json) pair, load_tier covers the by-name case, and M1.3 is the only consumer.
deviation_verdicts.plain catalogue-stats enforces the mediu: Accepted. Stricter than planned (the plan scoped the share to --tier medium), it is what CI runs, and 74.4% leaves 14 points of margin. TIER=medium still works.
deviation_verdicts.catalogue-inputs and the path filter bey: Accepted. It is the only way to fix the T4 finding (a pin that the fallback chain can reproduce) without a second script. The filter is tested hermetically (test_sky_assets.sh) and the real run exercised continue-then-exit-1 and the VizieR fallback. No regression found for make sky-assets, which only calls fetch textures with no filter.
deviation_verdicts.no negative control for catalogue-verify: Accepted after the fact. I ran one (one flipped byte: verify exits 1 and stats refuse the pair), so the gate is live. The author should have recorded it; it is cheap.
deviation_verdicts.process_stars.sh removed: Accepted. No live reference remains; SKILL.md and status.sh are consistent with the new pipeline.
